prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS2 mean temperature 41.5 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS1 mean temperature 35.9 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.98 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 403 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.8 % (6% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (2% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
